Clara (Marketing): Quick sync: finalize landing microcopy + launch posts for the tri-mode push. Need webinar CTA, routing, and two short hero options.
Diego (Growth): routing reminder: hosted -> self-serve; dedicated -> demo request (SDR); private -> enterprise contact. Add hidden form field deployment_interest and map to utm_campaign=tri_orbit.
Sam (PM): webinar is Tue 10am PT. Slides: latency, cost/token, p95 tail + a conservative real-app example (vector search, ~6k tokens). Speakers: Sam + Kai (infra) + Casey (customer ops).
Rina (Design): proposed hero lines:
- Hosted: "Ship LLM features in hours"
- Dedicated: "Predictable throughput for production"
- Private: "Inference inside your VPC"
Clara (Marketing): alternate compact hero for banner: "One API. Any deployment. Predictable inference." keeps mobile footprint small.
Diego (Growth): social short (X): "One API. Any deployment. See latency & cost benchmarks live: <link>" LinkedIn longer: include "migration playbook" and demo ask.
Omar (EngOps): webhook mapping example I'll implement. Form field slugs: deployment_interest -> values: hosted|dedicated|private. Example payload: {"utm_campaign":"tri_orbit","interest":"dedicated"}
Sam (PM): include one form question: "Which deployment are you evaluating?" use answers to route registrants to the right nurture path.
Rina (Design): CTA A/B test: CTA_A="Register — See Benchmarks" vs CTA_B="Register — Get Migration Playbook". I'll put variant IDs in the spec.
Clara (Marketing): landing microcopy draft: "Ship features fast with Redwood Inference. Use one consistent API across Hosted, Dedicated, and Private deployments. Choose Hosted to move fast, Dedicated for predictable throughput, or Private to keep inference inside your VPC. Register for our webinar to see benchmark demos and a migration playbook." Thoughts?
Diego (Growth): good. Trim for hero: "One API. Any deployment. Predictable performance."
Omar (EngOps): confirm webhook and variant_id wiring before EOD. I'll add tags interest:hosted|dedicated|private and variant: A|B.
remind-bot: Reminder set for Tuesday 2024-10-15 10:00:00 PT — Tri-mode webinar dry run.
Clara (Marketing): action list: 1) Rina upload hero comps 2) Omar share final slugs + webhook spec 3) Diego draft two social posts 4) Sam finalize slide with numbers. I'll push copy to staging and drop the preview link in here when live. :white_check_mark:
